[NRTM.2.2] Each setter takes `0` to mean "use the default":

| Setter | Controls | Default | Embedded recommendation |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ds_engine_set_rt_token_depth`    | `k_max`, the per-token embedded `facts[]` length (`tok_size = 32 + k_max×4` on 32-bit) | 16 | 4 (e.g. SAMD51) |
| `ds_engine_set_rt_token_pool_cap` | token pool capacity | `N_max × 8` | `N_max × 2` or `× 4` |
| `ds_engine_set_rt_presz_cap`      | hash-table pre-size for alpha / beta / terminal / WM tables | `next_pow2(N_max × 4)` | `N_max` (e.g. 64) |

The desktop defaults size for heavy churn; the embedded recommendations avoid
multi-kilobyte-per-terminal allocations on constrained targets.
